result.summary: Validates cached extended public keys (xpubs) when reading descriptor caches from the wallet database, rejecting invalid public keys with DBErrors::CORRUPT. This ensures corrupted cached xpubs in wallet files report database corruption at load time instead of deserializing into empty keys.
result.problem: If a wallet database contains an invalid cached xpub (such as an invalid curve point, or depth 0 with a non-zero child number or fingerprint), deserialization empties the key without error, and subsequent key derivation aborts the process in a CPubKey::Derive assertion.
evidence: "A wallet file whose descriptor cache holds an invalid extended public key aborts the process at load, in an assertion in CPubKey::Derive." (PR description)
"A modified wallet file aborted bitcoin-wallet before and reports a corrupt wallet now." (PR description)
result.changed_since_previous: No functional changes to the implementation; diff matches the previous description.
result.card: Validates cached extended public keys (xpubs) when loading descriptor records from the wallet database, returning DBErrors::CORRUPT if deserialization yields an invalid public key. Previously, malformed or corrupted cached xpubs were loaded as empty keys and later triggered an assertion failure in CPubKey::Derive during load, crashing the wallet tool or node. This converts an unhandled crash into a clean wallet corruption error.

risk.why: A mistake in the validation check could falsely mark valid wallet cache records as corrupt and fail wallet loading.
